name: Eclipse Design Gate
principle: One shared quality bar, distinct product character

profiles.cinematic: Public storytelling with one dominant visual anchor and static-first content.
profiles.product: Artifact-first workspaces with one restrained ambient anchor.
profiles.operational: Dense task surfaces where state, evidence and the next safe action dominate.

requiredChecks.label: Purpose, state and primary action are clear without instructions.
One action is visually primary and competing actions are quieter.
Public product claims include a live screenshot, artifact or labeled prototype evidence.
Loading, empty, error, success, disabled and focus states are covered when applicable.
Desktop and mobile evidence exists with no page-level overflow.
The primary path works by keyboard and has visible focus.
Reduced motion removes spatial motion while preserving feedback.
Auto-playing motion longer than five seconds has a visible pause control.
The project records a bundle or performance delta for the changed surface.
External references, assets, fonts and dependencies have recorded provenance and licenses.
No secrets, unsafe rendering, fake proof or unsupported production claims are introduced.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Three equal-weight cards in a row
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Explain why all three choices deserve equal priority or introduce hierarchy.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Shadow under every block
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Shadow must communicate elevation or interaction.

antiSlopSignals.signal: One radius applied to every object
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Radius follows component role and nesting.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Default purple-blue AI gradient
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Use the owned Eclipse gold/signal palette or document a product-specific semantic need.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Blurred colored blobs used as background filler
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Use owned eclipse geometry or remove the filler.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Inter or Geist used as an undifferentiated display face
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Use the product display type or explain the operational exception.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Gradient inside a heading
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Prefer solid hierarchy; reserve material gradients for non-text visual objects.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Emoji used instead of a product icon
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Use the established icon family or a text label.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Icon attached to every item without meaning
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Each icon must improve recognition or state communication.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Heading and supporting copy have the same weight
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Demonstrate a readable hierarchy at desktop and mobile sizes.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Two adjacent actions are equally bright
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Choose one primary action and make the alternative quieter.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Long paragraphs are centered
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Long-form copy uses a readable left-aligned measure.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Every section uses identical spacing
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Spacing reflects narrative or task rhythm.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Translucent white border on every card
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Borders communicate ownership, state or grouping.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Equal-block bento grid used by default
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Information architecture determines block weight.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Generic three-step how-it-works row
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Steps must reflect the real product workflow.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Three pricing tiers with the middle highlighted by default
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Packaging is backed by a real offer and user choice model.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Testimonials use invented names or repeated avatars
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Use consented, attributable proof or omit the section.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Trusted-by claim has no real logos
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Use verified relationships or remove the claim.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Round achievement numbers have no source
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Link the source, derive the number from a versioned registry or remove it.

antiSlopSignals.signal: FAQ answers questions with no user or search evidence
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Record the support, sales or search source for each question group.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Non-interactive block lifts on hover
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Hover affordance is reserved for something the user can activate.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Every section animates into view
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Motion marks meaningful transitions, not template repetition.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Footer contains dead or placeholder links
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Every visible link resolves or is removed.

antiSlopSignals.signal: Public product page contains no live product screenshot
antiSlopSignals.evidence: Show a current product surface or label the work explicitly as a concept.
